description: Plugin for llama.cpp's llama-server that runs MoE models bigger than your RAM (experts cached in RAM, the rest read from the SSD; output identical to stock). Experimental on Windows.
notes: Needs Python 3.8+. From v0.3.3 the kit includes the official llama.cpp Windows build (Vulkan) in its llama folder; your own llama-server (LLAMA_SERVER, PATH) still wins.
Run 'moe-cache' to open the control page (http://127.0.0.1:8070). Command line: python "$dir\bin\moe_cache.py" check MODEL.gguf --run
